problem.title: Generate All K-Length Strings from Given Characters
problem.problemStatement: Given a set of distinct characters and an integer K, generate all strings of length K. Characters may be reused any number of times. Print the strings in lexicographical order.
problem.input: Integer n Array characters Integer K
